subject: Packaging options and downgrade safety net for Sana pilot
messages:
From: Sana Smith <sana.procurement@sanasolutions.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Pablo Ortiz <pablo.ortiz@sanasolutions.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot packaging — options & downgrade worry

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team and I were impressed with latency and the routing controls. We're compiling requirements for a 3-month pilot and I have two quick asks around packaging before we move the procurement loop along: 

1) We expect usage to ramp from a few thousand tokens/day up to ~2M tokens/day. Can we start on a mid-tier and not be locked into a 12-month commitment if usage dips? Specifically: what downgrade options and proration look like (pricing and timeline).

2) We need two features bundled for the pilot: per-request token-level cost reporting (for billing back to product teams) and API-level KV cache for session continuity. Is there a compact bundle that includes these without forcing the full enterprise package?

Attached is our brief RFP (Sana_RFP_v2.pdf) and a sheet with estimated token volumes. Happy to jump on a call.

Best,
Sana
Sana Smith
Head of Procurement | Sana Solutions
Attachment: Sana_RFP_v2.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: pilot_estimates.csv (csv)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sana Smith <sana.procurement@sanasolutions.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging — options & downgrade worry

Hi Sana — thanks for the RFP and the clarity on volumes. Short answers up front, then specifics: 

- We can absolutely start mid-tier and provide a downgrade path; we offer a 30-day cooling window for pilots where you can step down tiers once with prorated credit toward future usage. We also provide a safety-net clause for unexpected volume drops during the pilot so you won't be auto-upgraded.

- There's a compact pilot bundle that includes token-level billing + KV cache as an add-on (we call it Pilot Insight Bundle). It keeps most enterprise-only features out of scope while giving the observability you need.

I'll let Ben add the numbers and Laura outline the exact contract language for proration. Proposed next step: 30-minute call tomorrow to walk the downgrade examples and show the bundle line items in the quote. Are you available 10–10:30am PT?

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sana Smith <sana.procurement@sanasolutions.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging — options & downgrade worry

Sana — looping in the pricing details below so you have concrete numbers for procurement: 

Pilot Insight Bundle (monthly, 3-month pilot)
- Mid tier compute: $6,000/month (reserved for pilot window)
- Token metering & token-level billing: $0.0025 per 1k tokens (billed monthly)
- KV cache add-on: $1,200/month (includes 50k session-store ops/day)
- Downgrade safety-net: single downgrade allowed once during pilot with proration credit = unused reserved compute days converted to credit at 100% against future reserved invoices; any token overages billed at metered rates.

Example: if you commit to mid-tier but drop after 20 days of a 30-day reserved month, you'll receive a 10-day credit toward the next invoice. We do not auto-upgrade you to a higher tier without signed approval.

Attached I've exported a sample schedule (pilot_pricing_schedule.xlsx) with three volume scenarios (low/expected/high) and the resulting monthly spend. If any of these assumptions look off, we can iterate.

Conflicts to flag: if you require SOC2 evidence or custom IP/data flow controls, that can push the pilot to the Dedicated track and changes pricing. Laura — can you confirm the SOC2 carve and whether pilot stays in hosted?

Thanks — happy to present this on a quick call. Rafael — 10am PT tomorrow works for me.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachment: pilot_pricing_schedule.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sana Smith <sana.procurement@sanasolutions.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Pablo Ortiz <pablo.ortiz@sanasolutions.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2027 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging — options & downgrade worry

Thanks Ben — this is exactly what procurement needed. A couple quick follow-ups: 

- Confirming pilot stays on hosted (no Dedicated) — we don't need SOC2 for the pilot, only later (good).
- Can you add a line item that covers a one-week extension for pilot handover (we may need +7 days at the end to complete integration tests)? If possible, list cost as a flat fee rather than a pro-rated compute increment.

We'll take the 10am PT slot tomorrow to review the schedule and get the mutual action plan documented. Pablo and I will bring procurement language we need in the SOW.

Best,
Sana
Sana Smith
Head of Procurement | Sana Solutions
